integrity: Exact algebraic cell transitions and proof of the infinite asymptotics; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Constructed deterministic bounded-gap time scale, a first spike at zero, and reset-to-threshold times up to five. Neither typicality nor nonlinear stochastic effects nor all first-spike phases are claimed. Periodic motif minimality concerns permutations of the same unordered gap multiset. Historical-equivalence risk persists.
title: Four-gap order dependence and failure of firing-rate convergence despite fixed clock marginals
